aboutLong:
I'm a Senior Software Engineer at Achievers based in Toronto, with over 10 years of experience across backend development, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, and developer tooling. Before joining Achievers, I spent more than nine years at Index Exchange, growing from an Operations Engineer into a Senior Software Engineer working on large-scale production systems.

With a background in Computer Science and Applied Mathematics, I enjoy solving complex technical problems, building reliable software, and continuously exploring new areas of engineering--from cloud infrastructure and distributed systems to AI-assisted development.
